meta.note: baseline is null everywhere: GTO baselines for 4-handed and 6-handed must come from solver exports Tiger supplies. Exploit answers are rule-based from opponent_profiles.json. A driver stat with n under 100 makes the spot lean (not graded).

defend_vs_wide_3bettor.title: Defend vs a wide 3-bettor
defend_vs_wide_3bettor.rule: Call wider in position with suited and playable hands; 4-bet only for value; fold weak offsuit hands.

three_bet_bluff_vs_non_folder.title: Do not 3-bet bluff a player who will not fold
three_bet_bluff_vs_non_folder.rule: Never 3-bet bluff; call playable hands and fold the rest.

iso_raise_limper.title: Raise over the limper
iso_raise_limper.rule: Raise 4-5bb with a wide range over his limp; he calls raises too often to fold out.

big_open_defense.title: Defend vs an oversized open
big_open_defense.rule: Tighten the calling range against a 5bb open; 3-bet for value.

defend_vs_wide_cbet.title: Defend vs a wide c-bettor
defend_vs_wide_cbet.rule: Call with any piece or a draw, raise strong hands; fold pure air.

river_vs_value_heavy_bettor.title: River bet from a value-heavy bettor
river_vs_value_heavy_bettor.rule: Call with top pair or better; fold bluff-catchers.

river_bluff_vs_over_folder.title: Bluff the river vs an over-folder

thin_value_vs_caller.title: Bet thin for value vs a caller
thin_value_vs_caller.rule: Bet 33-50% pot with second pair or weak top pair.

stab_vs_low_cbettor.title: Stab after he checks the flop
stab_vs_low_cbettor.rule: Bet 50-66% pot with weak hands and draws after he checks as the raiser.

barrel_vs_over_folder.title: Barrel the turn vs an over-folder
barrel_vs_over_folder.rule: Bet 66-75% pot on the turn with weak hands and draws.
